scope: Unbounded retry liveness for one durably tombstoned pack, independently reviewable I/O/progress contracts, four-client historical-tombstone cost

runtime_evidence.note: No new runtime Rust changes or re-run of the full wheel gate; current four-host probe validates this binary.

limitations: Liveness starts with a permanent durable tombstone; ownership/locking/replay composition and real I/O adapter refinement remain unproved.
Eventual storage recovery and fair I/O alone do not imply caller retries; there is no automatic retry daemon.
Successful modeled unlink (including truthful NotFound) must mean actual current absence; stale negative-cache behavior is not proved.
Generic controller progresses remains a direct premise; the new GC theorem does not use it.
GC measurements are repeated warm calls at 0/32/128 tombstones, include catalog lock/refresh, stat and directory sync, and do not isolate syscall costs.
Levels run in ascending order with uncontrolled cache/backend load; p99 is observational, not a deadline or proof premise.
No runtime GC optimization, new 100 GB bandwidth measurement or TB-scale physical test in this round.
